posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
In the name of shuffling the last of my Vengeance decks, I ran a game of the actual Freedom Five versus the actual Vengeful Five in the Ruins of Atlantis. It was glorious. Things got off to a rocky start, and Tachyon struggled a bit, but after about two rounds, we were shutting the villains down left and right. One round featured them being unable to deal damage, unable to play cards, and the environment unable to play cards. And Proletariat was so polite and helpful, first slowly killing himself and then shuffling all of Absolute Zero's ongoings back into his deck for him once he was ded. Such a nice young man; shame about the Communism. Plus I found out F5 Bunker is amaaaazing. The finale involved Absolute Zero auto-killing Fright Train, then sitting back and watching as Baron Blade was sucked under the waves by the Kraken. So satisfying.
 
After having so much fun, it's the perfect time for the complete opposite: Spite in Rook City. I played Agent of Gloom, but it didn't matter. America's Newest Legacy, Tachyon and that fan variant of Visionary answered the call, but could not withstand the onslaught. No big surprise there.
 
Next, I wanted to test out a brand-new custom deck, so it was [REDACTED], the Sentinels, the Hunted Naturalist, Argent Adept and Fanatic versus Plague Rat in the Realm of Discord. It was a short but intense game, I got a really good feel for how the Sentinels are supposed to work, and the custom deck was not overstated, if in need of some tweaking.
 
More testing! There was a robotic disturbance at the industrial plant, and Santa Guise, [REDACTED], Expatriette and America's Cleverest Legacy were on the scene, because I told myself I'd play him when regular Legacy came up in the rotation. :B It was a very close game, but Omnitron ended things with 10 HP. D:
 
One more test! This time, the Naturalist, Xtreme Tempest, Haka and [REDACTED] took on Voss in Omnitron-IV. I was really fearing this fight because I hate the environment, but the Naturalist's ability to deal with it (to say nothing of poor dead Tempest!) helped tremendously and landed him MVP.
